text:
These are the best picks, based on the guides I read. Prices differ between sections of the same articles, so check each listing before you buy.

**Best overall: Anker Prime Qi2 25W vent mount**
- It has active cooling, a firm hold and a vent clip that locks in quickly.
- It comes with a 60W car adapter, which the 25W mode needs. Anker backs it with a two-year warranty.
- It's the priciest pick, at about $70–90 depending on the section. The vent clip is also narrow.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)

**Best for fast charging: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan**
- This is a suction-base mount. It reaches 25W with the fan on and drops to 15W with it off.
- It includes a 95W car adapter and costs about $40.
- The base is large, so it may look oversized in a small cabin.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)

**Best budget: ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost**
- It has a built-in fan, clips to a vent or sticks to the dash, and holds Pro Max phones securely.
- The fan is faintly audible. Gadgeteer says the car adapter isn't included, and the ESR page doesn't say either way.
- Gadgeteer lists it between $19 and $36. ESR's own page lists $39.99, and Dealectric says code PARTNER18 brings that to $32.80. Dealectric tested the code on Oct 22, but checkout has the final word. Dealectric earns a commission on that link.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20) or [use the ESR deal link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Other good options**
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2** is a dash or windshield mount with a car charger included. It costs about $42 and has no fan. Windshield mounts are restricted in some states. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20)
- **EXELIQ cup holder mount** gives 15W and works if your car has no usable vent or dash space. The phone sits low, so it suits charging better than navigation. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20)
- **VICSEED Steel Core vent mount** doesn't charge. Its metal-core clip resists sagging, so it fits if you'd rather use a separate charger. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F916XVSW/?tag=moun05-20)

**Tips**
- Magnetic wireless chargers slow down when hot, and fans help with that. If you park in direct sun, pick a model with a fan, like the Anker, LISEN or ESR CryoBoost.
- For 25W you need an iPhone that supports Qi2.2 and an adapter that can supply enough power. The Anker and LISEN suction model include one.
- The Mountguys and Gadgeteer links are affiliate links.

If you tell me which car and iPhone you have, and whether you want a vent or dash mount, I can narrow this to one pick.
